## Installing

The installers are not code signed yet, so macOS and Windows warn on the first start:

- **macOS:** right click the app > Open, or System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway. Alternatively `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/backlog_manager.app`.
- **Windows:** More info > Run anyway.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x` the AppImage, or install the DEB or RPM with the package manager.

Details: [docs/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/theoleuthardt/backlog-manager/blob/main/docs/SIGNING.md).
